958 Beniamin {ben-ee-am-een'}

源自希伯來文 SNH01144; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Benjamin 4; 4

便雅憫 = "右手的兒子" 或, "好運的兒子"
1) 雅各的第十二個兒子
2) 便雅憫支派

958 Beniamin {ben-ee-am-een'}

of Hebrew origin 01144;; n pr m

AV - Benjamin 4; 4

Benjamin = "son of the right hand" or, "son of good fortune"
1) Jacob's twelfth son
2) the tribe of Benjamin
